## Description

While a shell owns the alternate screen and runs a foreground loop, growing the browser viewport changes the xterm grid but the pane's own `stty size` never changes — and still reports the pre-resize size after the TUI exits and the shell is back at a prompt.

## Reproduction

E2E fixture (PR #2131, unmerged), Relay and P2P:

1. Create/attach a session and wait for the interactive shell.
2. Submit: `printf '\033[?1049h'; printf '\033[?1h\033[?1000h\033[?2004h'; printf 'ALT-%s-TUI\n' 2130; while :; do sleep 0.5; printf 'ALT-%s-SIZE %s\n' 2130 "$(stty size)"; done`
3. Wait for `alternate` + the TUI marker.
4. `page.setViewportSize({ width: 1600, height: 1000 })`; poll `readGrid` until it grows (observed 32x124 → 46x164).
5. Observe the in-TUI `stty size` lines: they stay at `32 124` for the whole 15s deadline. Ctrl+C, leave the alternate screen, and `expectPtySize(page, 46, 164)` (the suite's #1187 helper) still times out with `32 124`.

The same suite's #1187 test (`a viewport resize reaches the PTY`) grows height at a shell prompt and passes, so the path works without the TUI/foreground job.

## Investigation Status

Root cause not yet verified. Candidate layers:

- `TerminalController`'s `ResizeController` sends the PTY resize only after `metricsAreProvisional()` is false (`document.fonts.status !== 'loading'`); not measured in this scenario.
- `ConnectionManager.sendResize` is gated on `isAttached()` and deduplicates against `lastSentResize`; the values observed (`46x164` vs seeded `32x124`) should pass.
- Relay vs P2P both reproduced, so a relay-routing bug is not required to explain it. Server logs during the run showed `Unknown message type: agent.terminal.resize` frames, but those may come from a lingering Agent peer after relay end.

## Impact

A TUI (htop/vim/alternate-screen application) would not follow a window change; the authoritative-resize guarantee (#1645 SC-02 / #1926 SC-07) is not true for the real TUI case even though the prompt case passes.

## Fix Direction

Instrument `ResizeController`/`ConnectionManager.sendResize` in the E2E stack to record whether a resize frame leaves the browser while the alternate buffer is active, and whether the Agent applies it (`resize_window`/PTY ioctl). Then fix the owner that drops it; re-enable the in-TUI `stty size` assertion in the TUI fixture (#2130).

## Location

- web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/controller/TerminalController.ts:734 — `ResizeController` (grid sizing and `reportSize` / PTY notify path)
- web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/controller/TerminalController.ts:788 — `metricsAreProvisional()` gate before `reportSize()`
- web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/ConnectionManager.ts:380 — `sendResize` (attach gate, `pendingResize`, `lastSentResize` dedup)
- e2e/tests/browser/terminal-io.spec.ts:257 — passing contrast case `a viewport resize reaches the PTY (#1187)`
- e2e/helpers/terminalRegression.ts:326 — `expectPtySize` helper used in reproduction step 5

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 When the viewport grows while an alt-screen TUI owns the screen, the pane's own tty reports the grid the browser shows, over both Relay and P2P.
- [ ] SC-02 The resize is never silently dropped: the fixture distinguishes a frame that never left the browser, an Agent refusal, and an accepted write the pane did not follow, at the exact PR head.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact PR HEAD Quality / E2E / Case Smoke / trusted Acceptance, and exact merge-SHA Quality / E2E / Cases / Orchestrator Pass.
